title: exacum quadrangulare
intro: Exacum quadrangulare, commonly known as four-angled exacum, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is used in traditional medicine, particularly in Ayurvedic and Unani practices, due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antidiabetic properties. The therapeutic actions of Exacum quadrangulare include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve wound healing, and exhibit antioxidant activity, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as iridoids, flavonoids, and alkaloids. Further research is necessary to fully understand the potential health benefits and mechanisms of action of Exacum quadrangulare.
